_notes: Sharpe_Net is annualized net of 0.22% friction per rebalance.

The 'Baseline (ML): Momentum + HMM' row below was generated by the (now missing) hybrid_backtester module; it differs from the production strategy at results/final_strategy/backtest_results.csv (Sharpe 0.833, CAGR 13.5%) which is what README and FINAL_REPORT cite. The discrepancy is preserved here rather than overwritten.

Component-removal rows: hybrid_minus_hmm and hybrid_minus_chronos are intentional aliases of existing scenarios because, by construction, removing HMM from the triple-expert collapses to the 50/50 simple hybrid, and removing Chronos collapses to momentum+HMM. hybrid_minus_momentum is not_run because the in-repo hybrid_backtester.py is absent.

scenarios.scenario: Hybrid minus HMM (alias of Simple Hybrid)
scenarios.interpretation: Removing HMM from the triple-expert in 2024-2026 IMPROVES Sharpe (0.54 -> 0.91). HMM cuts upside in clean bulls; this is consistent with the 4-window HMM ablation.

scenarios.scenario: Hybrid minus Chronos (alias of Phase 2 Momentum + HMM production)
scenarios.interpretation: Removing Chronos reverts to the Phase 2 production strategy. Sharpe 0.83 < Foundation-Only 1.34, confirming Chronos contributes the strongest single signal.

scenarios.scenario: Hybrid minus Momentum (Chronos + HMM sizing only)
scenarios.blocker: models/hybrid_backtester.py is referenced by scripts/run_diagnostic_ablation.py but absent on disk. Cannot regenerate without rebuilding that module. Recorded as not_run rather than fabricated.
